title: Local database is source of truth during daily operation
problem: Users must work seamlessly offline without knowing connectivity state.
question: Where is the authoritative data during daily pharmacy operations?
options: Local SQLite is source of truth; cloud syncs later
Cloud is source of truth; local is cache
decision: Local database is the source of truth during daily operation.
rejected_alternatives: Cloud is source of truth; local is cache

title: Delta sync — send only changed records
problem: Full-database upload is slow, expensive, and risky on reconnect.
question: What synchronization payload strategy should be used?
decision: Send only changed records; never upload the whole database.

title: Outbox pattern with background sync triggers
problem: Mutations must replicate reliably after crashes and intermittent connectivity.
question: How should local changes be queued and processed for cloud sync?
decision: Record every change in Outbox; background worker processes on app start, periodic interval, manual sync, and network reconnect.

title: Per-transaction UUID for idempotent sync requests
problem: Duplicate delivery after retries must not double-apply changes.
question: How should the server detect and ignore duplicate sync requests?
decision: Every transaction gets a unique UUID; server safely ignores duplicates.

title: Entity-specific conflict resolution rules
problem: Different entities have different correctness requirements when two writers conflict.
question: What conflict resolution strategy should apply globally?
decision: Entity-specific rules: inventory transaction-based (never overwrite stock), customer details may use last-write-wins, medicine master prefers server authority; use versions/timestamps for detection.
rejected_alternatives: Server always wins for all entities

title: Angular feature modules; no business logic in components
problem: UI layer must stay thin and testable.
question: How should the Angular client be structured?
decision: Use feature modules (sales, purchase, inventory, etc.); components call services only — never place business logic inside components.

title: Electron context isolation with preload contextBridge
problem: Renderer must not expose Node.js directly.
question: How should Electron expose OS capabilities to Angular?
decision: Renderer runs Angular only; main process handles printing/FS/windows/updates; use context isolation and preload script with contextBridge for required APIs.

title: NestJS thin controllers, rich services, validated DTOs
problem: HTTP layer and domain logic must stay separated.
question: Where should business rules live in the NestJS backend?
options: Controllers thin; services rich; DTOs validated
decision: Controller → DTO → Validation → Service → Prisma → SQLite; controllers thin, services rich, business rules in services.

title: REST with JSON envelope; binary streams for exports
problem: API responses need a consistent shape except for file downloads.
question: What response format should APIs use?
options: JSON envelope for data; binary for exports
decision: REST consistently; wrap JSON in `{ success, data }` / `{ success, error }`; report exports (`format=csv|xlsx|pdf`) return binary streams without JSON envelope.

title: Standard feature module folder anatomy
problem: New domain modules must follow one repeatable shape.
question: What folder layout should every backend feature module use?
decision: Follow party reference layout: module, thin controller, service, dto/, mappers/, optional constants/ and utils/.

title: Reads via PrismaService; writes via UnitOfWorkService
problem: Multi-row writes need atomicity; reads should stay simple.
question: When should Prisma be called directly vs through a transaction wrapper?
decision: List/get use `prisma.client`; every create/update/delete runs inside `unitOfWork.run(tx => …)`.

title: Audit and outbox in same transaction as mutation
problem: Audit/outbox rows must not commit without the business change.
question: When should audit and outbox be written?
options: Inside the same transaction as the mutation
decision: Every mutation calls `auditService.log(tx, …)` and `outboxService.enqueue(tx, …)` inside the same `tx`.

title: Read-only reports register into ReportRegistryService
problem: Each domain should not build its own report HTTP surface.
question: How should a new read-only report be exposed?
decision: Do not build a new controller; register a `ReportDefinition` provider into `ReportRegistryService`.

title: Additive-only change policy for backend extensions
problem: Feature work must not destabilize unrelated modules.
question: How should new features be added to the backend?
options: Refactor unrelated code while adding features
decision: Add new files and guarded logic; do not refactor or fix unrelated code without explicit approval.
rejected_alternatives: Refactor unrelated code while adding features

title: Central reporting core with domain provider registration
problem: Sales/inventory/purchase/finance reports must plug in without circular imports.
question: How should domain modules contribute reports?
options: Domain providers self-register at startup into global registry
Reporting core imports all domain modules
decision: Central `reporting` module owns execution/export; domain modules register `ReportDefinition`s at startup via `OnModuleInit` providers (inverted dependency).
rejected_alternatives: Reporting core imports all domain modules

title: Reports are read-only — no UnitOfWork, Outbox, or Audit
problem: Report runs must not create side effects or sync events.
question: Which persistence services may report providers use?
decision: Use `PrismaService.client` directly — no `UnitOfWorkService`, `OutboxService`, or `AuditService` on report runs.

title: Coarse REPORT_VIEW plus per-report permission
problem: Users need route-level and report-level access control.
question: How should report permissions be structured?
decision: `REPORT_VIEW` on routes; each `ReportDefinition.permission` checked before `run()`; catalog filtered via `listForUser()`.

title: Report exports: JSON, CSV, Excel, PDF
problem: Users need preview and downloadable exports.
question: Which export formats should v1 support?
decision: Support `format=json|csv|xlsx|pdf` (default json); exporters return buffer with Content-Type and Content-Disposition.

title: File exports bypass ResponseInterceptor via @Res
problem: Binary exports cannot use the JSON success envelope.
question: How should CSV/XLSX/PDF responses be returned?
decision: Use `@Res({ passthrough: false })` to stream exporter buffer with proper headers, bypassing `ResponseInterceptor` without modifying it.

title: Namespaced report IDs (domain.report-name)
problem: Report IDs must be unique and discoverable across domains.
question: How should report IDs be named?
decision: Use namespaced ids like `party.customer-list`; unique across registry.

title: Party reports provider ships first under reporting/providers
problem: Need a reference provider before other write modules exist.
question: Where should the first report provider live?
decision: `PartyReportsProvider` under `reporting/providers/party/` registers customer-list, supplier-list, customer-outstanding.

title: Export libraries: exceljs and pdfmake
problem: Need Excel and PDF generation without native build deps.
question: Which libraries should power XLSX and PDF export?
decision: Use `exceljs` for xlsx and `pdfmake` for tabular PDFs (Roboto fonts from package).

title: Inventory documents use nested item controllers
problem: Adjustment/transfer/stock-take are header+line documents edited incrementally.
question: Do inventory documents need separate item-level APIs?
options: Nested item controllers under parent routes
Items only via header create/update body
decision: Use separate nested item controllers (e.g. `/stock-adjustments/:id/items`) matching party nested-resource pattern.
rejected_alternatives: Items only via header create/update body

title: Inventory headers created without embedded items[]
problem: Lines are added while document is still editable.
question: Should create DTOs include line items?
options: Header create without items; add lines via item API
decision: Create DTOs for adjustment/transfer/stock-take have no `items[]`; items managed incrementally while parent is DRAFT (stock-take also IN_PROGRESS).

title: StockMovement HTTP API is read-only
problem: Movement ledger must be immutable.
question: Should StockMovement have create/update/delete endpoints?
options: Read-only HTTP; writes only via InventoryLedgerService
decision: StockMovement is immutable — read-only list/get HTTP; movements created only by `InventoryLedgerService.applyMovement`.

title: Batch org-global; Stock and documents branch-scoped
problem: Same lot can exist at multiple branches with independent quantities.
question: How should Batch vs Stock API scoping work?
decision: Batch list/get has no branch filter; Stock, adjustments, transfers, stock-takes filter by `RequestContext` branch.

title: Purchase v1 delivers all four document types
problem: Procurement lifecycle spans PO, GRN, invoice, and return.
question: What should we implement in the first backend delivery?
decision: All 4 document types in one delivery (PO + GRN + Invoice + Return).

title: Purchase status machines follow existing Prisma schema
problem: purchase.md, purchasing.md, and Prisma disagree on statuses.
question: Which source should the implementation follow?
options: MVP simplified workflows on Prisma columns
decision: Existing Prisma models in `backend/prisma/purchase/` are source of truth.
rejected_alternatives: MVP simplified workflows on Prisma columns

title: GRN full inspection workflow before stock IN
problem: Goods receipt quality inspection affects whether stock is accepted.
question: Goods Receipt posting workflow — how much complexity in v1?
decision: `DRAFT` → `UNDER_INSPECTION` → `ACCEPTED` / `PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED` / `REJECTED`; stock only on ACCEPTED.

title: Purchase invoice POST: status + audit + outbox only (no stock)
problem: Stock updates on GRN; invoice is financial document.
question: What should invoice POST do in v1?
decision: Invoice POST changes status + audit + outbox only — no stock movement.
rejected_alternatives: Stub ledger hook only at purchase planning time

title: Purchase full INVENTORY-style permission matrix
problem: Only PURCHASE_CREATE existed in seed.
question: What permission seeding should purchase v1 add?
options: Full matrix per resource + workflow actions
decision: Full matrix like inventory (READ/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE + workflow actions per PO, GRN, INVOICE, RETURN).

title: GRN without PO gated by ALLOW_GRN_WITHOUT_PO setting
problem: Ad-hoc receipts may or may not require a PO link.
question: Should v1 allow Goods Receipt without a linked Purchase Order?
decision: Allow GRN without PO when `ALLOW_GRN_WITHOUT_PO` app setting is enabled.

title: Posted GRN cancel reverses stock with OUT movements
problem: Cancelled receipts must undo inventory impact.
question: GRN cancellation / reversal in v1?
decision: Implement CANCEL on posted GRN with reversing OUT movements via InventoryLedgerService.

title: Purchase module tests deferred in v1
problem: First delivery prioritizes APIs over test suite.
question: What test coverage in first delivery?
decision: No tests in first pass.

title: Finance v1: Ledger, LedgerEntry, Payment, Receipt
problem: financial.md defines four core tables.
question: What should the first backend delivery include?
decision: All 4 `financial.md` tables: Ledger, LedgerEntry, Payment, Receipt.

title: Finance full cross-module hooks in v1
problem: Payments must affect purchase invoices and customer receipts.
question: How much cross-module integration in v1?
options: Full hooks incl. purchase invoice AP
decision: Full hooks: purchase invoice AP on post + supplier payment allocation + customer receipt (sales invoice stub).

title: Full LedgerPostingService with balance validation and reversal
problem: Payment/Receipt COMPLETE needs shared double-entry logic.
question: LedgerPostingService — required for v1?
options: Inline ledger writes in services only
decision: Full shared `LedgerPostingService` (balance validation, reversal helper, optional running balance).
rejected_alternatives: Inline ledger writes in services only

title: LedgerEntry HTTP API read-only
problem: Journal is immutable; entries created by posting flows.
question: LedgerEntry HTTP API in v1?
decision: Read-only list/get/filter by ledgerId, voucherType, date range.

title: Ledger COA full CRUD with hierarchy guards
problem: Chart of accounts must be admin-manageable.
question: Ledger (COA) API in v1?
decision: Full CRUD with parent hierarchy; block delete on system ledgers and circular parent.

title: Strict financial year validation on posts
problem: Transactions must land in an open FY.
question: Enforce open FinancialYear on payment/receipt post?
decision: Strict — reject posts outside current open financial year date range.

title: Payment/Receipt numbers globally unique per Prisma schema
problem: Prisma has globally unique paymentNumber/receiptNumber.
question: Payment/Receipt document numbers — follow Prisma or branch-scope?
decision: Prisma as-is: org-global unique numbers; use branch sequence row format like `PAY-{BR}-{SEQ}` to avoid collisions.

title: Expense Prisma model out of scope; use Payment EXPENSE type
problem: Expense model exists but not in financial.md table list.
question: Include Expense table in v1?
decision: Expense table out of scope; use `paymentType=EXPENSE` via Payment.

title: Finance module tests deferred in v1
problem: Match purchase v1 delivery pace.
question: Test coverage for first delivery?
decision: Deferred (no tests in v1).

title: Block purchase invoice cancel when paidAmount > 0
problem: Cancelling invoices with payments creates accounting inconsistency.
question: When posted purchase invoice has payments, how should cancel behave?
decision: Block cancel when `paidAmount > 0`; user must cancel finance payments first.
rejected_alternatives: Auto-cancel/unwind completed finance payments as part of invoice cancel

title: Ledger reversals scoped by voucherNumber with -REV suffix
problem: Reusing same voucherType+voucherId caused double-reversal bugs.
question: How to fix reversal without Prisma migration?
decision: No Prisma migration — scope originals by exact `voucherNumber`; post reversals under distinct `-REV` voucher number.

title: Reject unsupported PaymentType at complete
problem: Silent fallback to Supplier Payable masked misconfiguration.
question: How to handle unsupported PaymentType at complete?
decision: Reject with explicit error (no silent fallback).

title: Ledger running balance left best-effort in bug-fix pass
problem: Running balance correctness vs delivery scope.
question: Fix running balance locking in bug-fix pass?
decision: Leave running balance as best-effort (document only); no locking work in bug-fix pass.
rejected_alternatives: Add locking work in bug-fix pass

title: Sales v1 includes all five sales tables
problem: Sales domain includes invoices, payments, and returns.
question: Which sales documents should v1 include?
decision: All 5: SalesInvoice, SalesInvoiceItem, SalesPayment, SalesReturn, SalesReturnItem.

title: Sales full finance ledger integration
problem: Sales must mirror purchase+finance ledger patterns.
question: Finance / ledger integration on sales workflows?
decision: Full hooks: invoice post AR/revenue/GST, payment ledger, return reversal, posted cancel reversal.

title: SalesPayment nested API; Finance Receipt stays separate
problem: Two paths can record customer collections.
question: How should customer payments be recorded in v1?
decision: `SalesPayment` nested under invoice; Finance `Receipt` with SALES_INVOICE allocation stays separate.

title: Auto-resolve selling price from PriceList at post
problem: Prices are branch-scoped via PriceList.
question: Selling price resolution at invoice post?
decision: Auto-resolve from branch PriceList/PriceListItem at post; snapshot MRP/tax on lines.

title: FEFO batch allocation at sales invoice post
problem: Batch selection affects expiry compliance.
question: Batch selection for invoice lines?
options: User must pick batch on each line
decision: FEFO at post; draft may store suggested batch; post re-allocates and validates.
rejected_alternatives: User must pick batch on each line

title: Prescription FK validation only in sales v1
problem: Schedule H rules add complexity.
question: Prescription / Schedule H handling?
decision: Optional `prescriptionId` FK validation (exists + branch match); no Schedule H rules in v1.

title: Sales returns RESTOCK disposition only in v1
problem: Return dispositions include damaged/quarantine paths.
question: Sales return stock disposition on approve?
decision: RESTOCK only — approved returns create IN StockMovement; ignore DAMAGED/DISCARD routing.

title: Posted sales invoice cancel with stock and ledger reversal (initial v1)
problem: Exception workflow for posted invoices.
question: Cancel posted sales invoice?
decision: Implement `cancel` on posted invoice with stock reversal + ledger reversal.

title: Block sales invoice cancel when paid or completed returns exist
problem: Cancel with completed payments/returns caused ledger inconsistency.
question: Which simplification for posted sales invoice cancel?
options: Block when paidAmount > 0 or COMPLETED return
decision: Match purchase: block cancel when `paidAmount > 0` or any COMPLETED return exists.

title: Sales full permission matrix
problem: Need granular access like purchase/finance.
question: Permission matrix for sales endpoints?
decision: Full matrix + admin role assignment (READ/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE + POST/CANCEL/APPROVE per resource).

title: Sales module tests deferred in v1
problem: Match purchase/finance v1 pace.
question: Tests in v1?
decision: Deferred.

title: Security admin: all six doc tables plus UserBranch
problem: RBAC admin beyond auth login.
question: Which tables/APIs should v1 include?
decision: All 6 doc tables + UserBranch admin (User, Role, Permission, RolePermission, UserRole, UserSession, UserBranch).

title: Auth module for authentication; Security module for RBAC admin
problem: Login vs admin concerns must not be mixed.
question: Where should user/role admin live vs login?
options: New security/ module; auth/ keeps tokens
decision: New `backend/src/security/` for admin; `backend/src/auth/` keeps login/logout/refresh/me.

title: Admin reset, self change-password, and unlock flows
problem: Password management spans self-service and admin.
question: Which password flows in v1?
decision: Admin reset + unlock in security; self change-password in auth.

title: Permission full CRUD including system permissions
problem: Permission catalog must be admin-manageable.
question: Permission CRUD scope?
decision: Full CRUD on Permission rows including `isSystemPermission`.

title: Junction APIs nested with bulk replace
problem: Role-permission and user-role assignments need bulk updates.
question: Junction API shape?
decision: Nested under parent + add/remove + bulk **replace** (UserRole, RolePermission pattern).

title: UserSession read and admin force-logout
problem: Admins must revoke active sessions.
question: UserSession API scope?
decision: Read list/get + admin `force-logout` endpoint.

title: Employee link FK validation only
problem: User may link to employee party record.
question: Employee integration depth?
decision: FK validation only — employee exists, no duplicate user per employee.

title: Invalidate sessions on deactivate, password reset, role changes
problem: Stale sessions after privilege changes are a security risk.
question: When to force-logout all user sessions?
decision: Force-logout all active sessions on user deactivate, password reset, and role/permission assignment changes.

title: Full SECURITY:RESOURCE:ACTION permission matrix
problem: Admin APIs need granular guards.
question: Permission seed model?
decision: Full `SECURITY:RESOURCE:ACTION` matrix + admin role seed assignment.

title: Security module tests deferred in v1
problem: Match other module v1 deliveries.
question: Tests in v1?
decision: Deferred.

title: Medicine master backend-only v1
problem: Need APIs before Angular admin UI.
question: Implementation scope?
decision: Backend only — APIs, permissions seed, cursor rules, AGENTS.md (no Angular UI, tests deferred).

title: Full MASTER:RESOURCE:ACTION permission matrix
problem: Eight medicine master resources need granular access.
question: Permission model for all 8 resources?
decision: Full `MASTER:RESOURCE:ACTION` matrix + `REPLACE` for `MEDICINE_SALT`.

title: Manufacturer requires existing Party (FK validation only)
problem: Manufacturer links to party master.
question: Manufacturer ↔ Party integration?
decision: Create Party first, then Manufacturer with `partyId` (mirror Supplier pattern).

title: MedicineSalt nested CRUD + PUT replace
problem: Medicine composition is a junction collection.
question: MedicineSalt API under /medicines/:id/salts?
decision: Nested under `/medicines/:medicineId/salts` — CRUD + `PUT .../replace`.

title: System schedule/UOM rows: full CRUD; block delete on FK refs only
problem: System rows vs custom rows delete policy differs.
question: System schedules/UOMs delete policy?
decision: Full CRUD — block delete only when FK references exist; `isSystemSchedule`/`isSystemUnit` not special-cased.
rejected_alternatives: Block delete when isSystem flag true

title: Strict soft-delete guards on medicine masters
problem: Deleting referenced masters corrupts downstream data.
question: Soft-delete guards when downstream references exist?
decision: Strict — block soft-delete when downstream refs exist (medicines, batches, children, junctions, etc.).

title: Client provides unique medicineCode
problem: Medicine identity code assignment.
question: Medicine code on create?
decision: Client provides `medicineCode` (validated unique).

title: medicineName unique within manufacturerId
problem: Name collisions within a manufacturer's catalog.
question: Medicine name uniqueness rule?
decision: `medicineName` unique within `manufacturerId`.

title: MedicineCategory flat CRUD with circular-parent guard
problem: Category hierarchy without dedicated tree API.
question: MedicineCategory hierarchy API?
decision: Flat CRUD with `parentCategoryId` + circular-parent validation; no tree endpoint.
rejected_alternatives: Tree read-only client-built only without validation

title: MedicineSalt schema unchanged; hard-delete junction rows
problem: Prisma gap: no deletedAt on MedicineSalt.
question: Handle MedicineSalt schema gap how?
decision: No schema change — hard-delete junction rows; auto-set `medicineGenericId` from `SaltComposition.genericId` on create.

title: Medicine fix plan covers all reviewed issues
problem: Post-implementation review found bugs across priority levels.
question: Which issues should the fix plan include?
decision: Fix all reviewed issues (high, medium, and low).

title: UnitType PACK→PACKAGING in constants and seed JSON only
problem: UnitType enum misaligned with domain doc.
question: How to handle PACK → PACKAGING alignment?
decision: Update constants + seed JSON only (no load-masters migration; existing DBs update on `db:seed:fresh`).

title: Pricing, Prescription, and Audit delivered together
problem: Three related doc domains share permission and audit patterns.
question: Delivery scope for these three doc domains?
decision: One plan — implement all three backend modules together.

title: Pricing/Prescription/Audit backend-only; tests deferred
problem: Match Medicine/Security delivery pattern.
question: Implementation scope?
decision: Backend only — APIs, permissions seed, cursor rules, AGENTS.md (no Angular UI, tests deferred).

title: PriceList branch-scoped list includes org-wide lists
problem: Some price lists apply org-wide (null branchId).
question: PriceList branch scope for list API?
decision: Default JWT branchId + include org-wide lists (`branchId` null); optional `branchId` query override for admin.

title: Enforce single default PriceList per branch scope on set
problem: Multiple defaults cause ambiguous pricing.
question: Default price list behavior?
decision: When `isDefault=true`, clear other defaults for same branch (including null branch scope) in create/update.

title: PriceListItem nested CRUD + PUT replace
problem: Price lines are a collection under a list.
question: PriceListItem API shape?
decision: Nested `/price-lists/:priceListId/items` + `PUT .../replace`.

title: Tax and DiscountRule full CRUD; block delete on FK refs
problem: Rate changes vs referential integrity.
question: Tax/DiscountRule edit policy when used?
options: Full CRUD block delete on FK
decision: Full CRUD — block delete only when FK references exist.

title: Prescription lifecycle via workflow POST routes
problem: Prescription status transitions are workflow actions.
question: Prescription lifecycle API shape?
decision: `POST activate`, `POST cancel`, `POST expire`; item CRUD only in `DRAFT`.

title: Client provides unique prescriptionNumber
problem: Prescription document identity.
question: Prescription number on create?
decision: Client provides `prescriptionNumber` (unique).

title: PrescriptionItem dispensed fields read-only via API
problem: Dispensing progress updated by sales later.
question: PrescriptionItem API + dispensing fields?
decision: Nested CRUD + replace; `dispensedQuantity`/`remainingQuantity`/item `status` read-only via API.
rejected_alternatives: Items managed only via header body

title: Sales dispensing hook out of scope for prescription v1
problem: Invoice post could update prescription progress.
question: Sales invoice post → update prescription dispensing?
decision: Out of scope — prescription CRUD only; sales keeps FK validation only.
rejected_alternatives: In scope — update dispensedQuantity on SalesInvoice post

title: Audit read APIs plus ChangeHistory on UPDATE
problem: ChangeHistory never written today.
question: Audit module scope?
decision: Read APIs for AuditLog/ChangeHistory + extend AuditService to write ChangeHistory on UPDATE (pricing/prescription v1).

title: Audit lists default-filter by JWT branchId
problem: Audit data is branch-sensitive.
question: AuditLog / ChangeHistory list filtering?
decision: Default filter by JWT `branchId`; optional entityType/entityUuid/userId/date range/correlationId.
rejected_alternatives: Entity-scoped trail as primary API only

title: Full PRICING + PRESCRIPTION + AUDIT permission matrices
problem: Each resource needs granular guards.
question: Permission seed model?
decision: Full `PRICING` + `PRESCRIPTION` + `AUDIT` resource matrices.

title: Configuration, Sync, and Masters delivered together
problem: Org config, sync admin, and geo lookups share patterns.
question: Delivery scope for these three doc domains?
decision: One combined implementation for Configuration + Sync + Masters lookup modules.

title: SCM modules backend-only; tests deferred
problem: Match prior module delivery pattern.
question: Implementation scope?
decision: Backend only — APIs, permissions seed, cursor rules, AGENTS.md (no Angular UI, tests deferred).

title: Extend SettingsModule with AppSetting create/get/delete
problem: Settings today is list+update only.
question: Relationship with existing SettingsModule?
options: Extend SettingsModule with full AppSetting CRUD
New config module for all incl. AppSetting
decision: Extend existing SettingsModule — add create/get/delete; keep `GET /settings` + `PUT /settings/:key`.
rejected_alternatives: New configuration/ module for ALL incl. AppSetting

title: New configuration/ module for Company, Branch, FY, sequences, printer, barcode
problem: Org and device config tables need admin APIs.
question: Where do non-AppSetting config tables live?
decision: New `configuration/` module for Company, Branch, FinancialYear, SequenceGenerator, PrinterConfiguration, BarcodeConfiguration.

title: FinancialYear full CRUD plus POST close workflow
problem: FY must be closable by admin.
question: FinancialYear admin API?
decision: Full CRUD + `POST /financial-years/:id/close` (OPEN → CLOSED).

title: SequenceGenerator admin CRUD; allocation stays internal
problem: Admins configure sequences; runtime allocates numbers.
question: SequenceGenerator HTTP API?
decision: Admin CRUD for sequence config; `SequenceGeneratorService.next()` stays internal.

title: Company and Branch full CRUD with default/head-office guards
problem: Org structure must enforce single default company and head office.
question: Company / Branch admin?
decision: Full CRUD for Company and Branch with `isDefault` / `isHeadOffice` single-flag enforcement.

title: Sync admin: outbox read+retry, conflict resolve; no cloud worker
problem: Outbox write exists; admin needs visibility and retry.
question: Synchronization module HTTP scope?
decision: Outbox read + `POST :id/retry`; SyncLog read-only; SyncConflict read + `POST :id/resolve` — no cloud worker.

title: Geographic masters as flat CRUD per entity
problem: Country→State→City→Area hierarchy needs admin APIs.
question: Geographic masters API shape?
options: Flat CRUD per entity with parent FK
decision: Flat CRUD per entity (`/countries`, `/states`, `/cities`, `/areas`) with parent FK + circular guards.

title: Strict soft-delete reference checks for config and masters
problem: Deleting referenced geo/org rows breaks FK integrity.
question: Soft-delete guards?
decision: Strict — block soft-delete when referenced (PartyAddress, Branch, transactions, child geo rows, etc.).
rejected_alternatives: Strict for Company/Branch/FY; geo soft-delete freely

title: ChangeHistory on UPDATE for configuration and masters v1
problem: Field-level audit for config changes.
question: ChangeHistory integration for configuration and masters?
decision: Emit ChangeHistory on UPDATE for configuration + masters modules (v1).

title: Full CONFIGURATION + SYNC + LOOKUP matrix; keep SETTINGS_* and SYNC_RUN
problem: Existing SETTINGS_READ/UPDATE and SYNC_RUN must remain.
question: Permission seed model?
options: Extend SETTINGS/SYNC_RUN + matrix for new resources
decision: Full CONFIGURATION + SYNC + LOOKUP resource matrices; keep existing `SETTINGS_READ/UPDATE` + `SYNC_RUN`.
rejected_alternatives: Extend SETTINGS/SYNC_RUN only without full matrix

title: SCM fix plan includes all review items
problem: Post-implementation review found high through low issues.
question: Which issues should the fix plan include?
decision: Fix all issues from the review (high + medium + low/maintainability).
rejected_alternatives: High + medium only — defer renames and company scoping

title: Skip Area delete guard — PartyAddress has no areaId
problem: Schema lacks areaId on PartyAddress.
question: Area delete guard handling?
decision: Skip Area delete guard — document schema gap (`PartyAddress` has no `areaId`).
rejected_alternatives: Document only; plan follow-up schema change

title: Company API tenant-scoped to JWT companyId
problem: Company list was org-global inconsistent with Branch pattern.
question: Company API tenant scoping?
decision: Scope Company list/get/update/delete to JWT `companyId` (match Branch/FY pattern).

title: Block SequenceGenerator DELETE when isActive=true
problem: Hard delete of active sequences is dangerous.
question: SequenceGenerator hard delete risk?
decision: Block hard-delete when `isActive=true` — admin must deactivate first.
rejected_alternatives: Keep hard delete document danger only

title: Settings PUT requires version in body (breaking change)
problem: Concurrent settings updates need optimistic locking.
question: Settings PUT optimistic locking?
decision: Add **required** `version` in `PUT /settings/:key` body (breaking API change).

title: FinancialYear isCurrent remains branch-scoped
problem: Review questioned isCurrent exclusivity across branches.
question: FinancialYear isCurrent exclusivity?
decision: Keep branch-scoped `isCurrent` behavior — document as intentional.
rejected_alternatives: Setting isCurrent clears ALL current FYs for company

title: SCM simplification covers P1+P2+P3 cleanup
problem: Optional post-fix structural cleanup.
question: How much should simplification plan cover?
decision: P1 + P2 + P3 — lint fix, branch-scope util move, validateBranchId dedupe, settings mapper ISO dates, early-foundations API table, settings agent docs, optimisticUpdate in settings.service.
